Bill Gates vs the world chess champion. Who wins?
In 2014, on the TV show Skavlan, Bill Gates played Magnus Carlsen. Carlsen gave him 2 minutes on the clock and kept only 30 seconds for himself. Gates took a free bishop and was checkmated two moves later: 9 moves, 79 seconds. In 2025 Carlsen beat ChatGPT in 53 moves without losing a single piece.
How long would you last against Magnus?

posts.ig_caption:
Caught cheating on the toilet.
In 2019, at a tournament in Strasbourg, 58-year-old grandmaster Igors Rausis was photographed in the toilet with his phone. He had climbed from 2518 to 2686 in six years and was the oldest player in the world's top 100. He signed that the phone was his, admitted cheating, lost his grandmaster title and got a six-year ban.
Today a free app on any phone plays better than any human. Joker Chess adds one jump per game, and the big engines weren't built for it. Free, link in bio.
Should cheaters get a lifetime ban?
#chess #chesscheating #chessnews #grandmaster #chessfacts #jokerchess

posts.ig_caption:
He beat Magnus. Magnus quit.
On 4 September 2022, at the Sinquefield Cup, 19-year-old Hans Niemann beat world champion Magnus Carlsen with Black. The next day Carlsen quit the tournament and hinted that Niemann had cheated. Two weeks later, online, Carlsen resigned after one move. Niemann admitted cheating online as a kid but denied ever cheating over the board. He sued for 100 million dollars, and in 2023 both sides settled; Carlsen said there was no clear proof that Niemann cheated in their game.
If they ever play again: Joker Chess, a version nobody can prepare at home. Free, link in bio.
#chess #magnuscarlsen #hansniemann #sinquefieldcup #chessnews #jokerchess
Video: Saint Louis Chess Club. Photos: Magnus Carlsen, 2023, and Hans Niemann, 2024: Frans Peeters (CC BY-SA 2.0). Game: Carlsen-Niemann, Sinquefield Cup 2022, round 3.

posts.ig_caption:
Chess has a draw problem.
1984: Karpov vs Kasparov, 48 games, 40 draws, stopped after five months with no winner. 2018: Carlsen vs Caruana, all 12 classical games drawn. 2024: Gukesh vs Ding, 9 draws in 14 games, decided by one mistake in the very last game.
People tried shuffled pieces, bughouse, even a duck on the board. Joker Chess keeps the normal start and adds one jump per player. Free, link in bio.
Too many draws, or is that just chess at the top?
#chess #worldchesschampionship #magnuscarlsen #gukesh #kasparov #jokerchess
